content: Added resources_dir to apply_set (gap vs other *_dir fields) and to --set help text. Added named match arms for synthetic_dir/generated_dir/csnotes_dir (dangerous), recording_qualifiers/courses_without_recordings/sources_ignore_dirs (lists), skill_variant/snapshot_mode (internal enums) — all with actionable error messages instead of generic 'invalid or read-only'.
